description.value:
The Consular is a full Force caster who has devoted their life to study and contemplation of the Force, wielding it as a scholar-priest wields both scripture and scalpel. Blending the roles of healer, diplomat, and battlefield controller, the Consular draws on the full depth of the Force power list — light or dark, or a measured balance of both — to protect allies, manipulate the minds of the weak-willed, and reshape the flow of battle before a single blow is struck.

Where the Guardian and Sentinel bring the Force to bear through a blade, the Consular brings it to bear through will alone, layering Force-Empowered Casting techniques atop an already formidable array of powers as they advance. A Consular is rarely the strongest melee combatant in a party, but is often the reason the rest of the party survives at all.
